label: Tab group
description: A set of tabs inside a column that shows one panel at a time. Use it to keep secondary content — activity, related records, audit history — one click away without lengthening the page. The selected tab is reflected in the URL so a shared link opens the same tab.
usage: Use 2–5 tabs with short noun titles ("Activity", "Child tickets", "History").
Put the tab people need most first, or set defaultTab to it.
Do not hide required fields in a non-default tab; keep them in the main body.
constraints: Parent must be layout.column; children must be layout.tab nodes (at most 8).
defaultTab, when set, must be the node ID of one of its child tabs; otherwise the first visible tab opens.
Tab groups cannot nest: layout.tab does not accept layout.tab_group.

defaultTab.description: Node ID of the child layout.tab selected on first load.

binding.description: Structural only; tab contents bind to the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Left/Right arrows move between tabs, Home/End jump to the first/last tab, Enter or Space activates (manual activation). Tab moves into the panel.
accessibility.notes: Each tab has aria-selected and aria-controls; panels are role tabpanel labelled by their tab. Tabs hidden by rules are removed from the tablist, not disabled.

responsive: Below 720px the tab strip scrolls horizontally with edge fades; it never wraps to a second line.

examples.description: Activity, child tickets, and history tabs, opening on Activity
